title: Nothing OS 4.1 (Pong-B4.1-261014-1615)
description:
What's New in This Update General Improvements and Bug Fixes

🎞️ Improved playback smoothness for videos recorded at 1080P 60FPS.
🔗 Optimised Bluetooth connection stability when activating the voice assistant.
🛜 Fixed an issue where the Wi-Fi hotspot frequency did not match the selection in certain cases.
⚙️ Enhanced overall system stability.
🛡️ Updated to October 2026 security patch.

Notes:
Your device may use more power and feel warmer during installation. Performance will return to normal after the update is complete.
